title: harpalyce altissima
intro: Harpalyce altissima, commonly known as Wild Pigeon Pea, is a species of flowering plant in the family Fabaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine for its various health benefits, including its potential to reduce inflammation, improve digestion, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Harpalyce altissima are attributed to its bioactive constituents, such as flavonoids and alkaloids, which may possess antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
